name: Info Edge (India) Ltd.
about: Info Edge (India) Limited operates as an online classifieds company in the areas of recruitment, matrimony, real estate, and education and related services in India and internationally. It operates through Recruitment Solutions, 99acres for Real Estate, and Other segments. The company provides recruitment services through Naukri.com, an online job website for job seekers and corporate customers, including hiring consultants/firms; Naukrigulf.com, a website catering to Gulf markets; Quadranglesearch.com, a site that provides off-line placement services to middle and senior management; zwayam.com; codingninjas.com; iimjobs.com, hirist.com, doselect.com, Naukri Fast Forward; ambitionbox.com; and jobhai.com.
